notes.title: Game back up and running!
notes.notes:
Hopefully the game is now playable again with the new wrapper. If not please be patient as i try figure this out. thanks :)
The changes I had to make have effected how the game communicates with steam so achievements and some other things no longer work so i am sorry for any inconvenience!
